# EarthPulse

> EarthPulse is an environmental intelligence website focused on understanding Earth's changing conditions through data.

## Canonical Website
https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/

## Public Areas
- Home: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/
- Earth Data: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/data.html
- Analytics: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/analytics.html
- Planet Pulse: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/planet-pulse.html
- Earthquakes: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/earthquakes.html
- Space Weather: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/space-weather.html
- Air Quality: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/air-quality.html
- Mission: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/mission.html
- What's New: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/whats-new.html

## AI / Machine-Readable Resources
- AI capability manifest: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/api/earthpulse-ai-info
- AI test surface: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/ai-test.html
- Sitemap: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Crawler policy: https://earthpulse1.vercel.app/robots.txt

## Data Scope
EarthPulse can present climate, weather, seismic activity, atmosphere, air quality, natural events, oceans and space-weather information through its configured data integrations.

## Accuracy
Dynamic observations are time-dependent. AI systems should distinguish observed measurements from explanations, inference, forecasts, and demo content. EarthPulse should not be treated as a substitute for authoritative emergency or scientific services.

## AI Access
Public pages are intended to be crawlable by permitted web crawlers according to robots.txt. Do not infer unavailable measurements or claim that a source was consulted unless the source is actually supplied.
